tools.name: fiix_find_objects
tools.description: Find objects of one Fiix class (Account, Asset, PurchaseOrder, WorkOrder), optionally filtered by a Fiix QL expression with ? placeholders. Returns the objects with the fields you name, plus the total match count. Uses one Fiix API call per request (1,000 calls per day per user license).

tools.name: fiix_get_object
tools.description: Read one Fiix object of a class by its numeric id, with the fields you name.

tools.name: fiix_count_objects
tools.description: Count the Fiix objects of one class that match an optional Fiix QL filter. Returns only the total. Uses one Fiix API call per request (1,000 calls per day per user license).
